subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should OpenClaw land this PR with `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool and optional `WriteOperations.appendFile`, or require a `mode` field or separate append tool before merging?
rationale: The data-loss problem and implementation direction are well supported, but the permanent model-facing and SDK-reexported write contract is a maintainer-owned API/product decision.

options.title: Accept append boolean
options.body: Land this narrower branch after exact-head validation if maintainers want the smallest default-preserving extension to the existing write tool.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Ask the contributor to replace the boolean with a `mode` field or separate append tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation or future extensibility.

options.title: Use the older branch as canonical
options.body: Pause this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77127 is intentionally chosen as the maintained landing path despite its broader diff.

recommendation.title: Accept append boolean
recommendation.body: Land this narrower branch after exact-head validation if maintainers want the smallest default-preserving extension to the existing write tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for structured agent tool definitions and the model-facing API boundary involved here.
